t2.title: Music have therapeutic benefits
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Does music have therapeutic benefits?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Music therapy is gaining recognition in healthcare. I firmly believe music offers significant therapeutic benefits for both mental and physical health.

Firstly, music reduces stress and anxiety. Listening to calm music lowers cortisol levels and heart rate. Many people use music to relax after stressful days, and hospitals now play soothing music for patients.

Secondly, music aids cognitive function. Studies show music improves memory and concentration. For Alzheimer's patients, familiar songs can trigger memories and improve mood remarkably.

However, critics argue scientific evidence is still limited. Some benefits may be placebo effects, and music affects individuals differently.

Nevertheless, the emotional power of music is undeniable. It can elevate mood, provide comfort during grief, and motivate during exercise. These psychological benefits are widely experienced.

Furthermore, music therapy is now used professionally. Trained therapists help patients with depression, autism, and pain management through structured musical activities.

In conclusion, music's healing potential is real and valuable. Everyone should incorporate music into their wellness routine.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear Student Magazine,

I think music has therapeutic benefits. In my opinion, it can help people feel better. For example, when I am sad, I listen to happy music, and it makes me feel happier. Also, music can help people relax. When I am stressed, I listen to calming music.

However, some people might not like music. Maybe it doesn't help everyone. But I think it helps most people. Music can also help people concentrate when they are studying. For example, I listen to music when I do my homework.

In conclusion, I believe music is good for people. It can help with stress, sadness, and even studying.

Sincerely,

Farrux Yusupov
t2.sampleB2:
Have you ever noticed how the right song can turn a rotten day around? For most of us, music is far more than background noise — and there is growing proof that it does us real good.

To begin with, music works wonders for stress. A few minutes of a calm melody slows the heart rate and brings down cortisol, the hormone behind that wound-up feeling. This is exactly why hospitals now play soft music to settle nervous patients before surgery.

On top of that, music can lift our spirits like almost nothing else. A cheerful tune can chase away gloom in seconds, and therapists even use songs to reach people struggling with depression or memory loss. A familiar melody often brings back memories that words simply cannot.

Of course, sceptics point out that we all react differently, and the science is still catching up. Even so, the sheer number of people who turn to music in tough times speaks volumes.

All things considered, music is a powerful, affordable form of therapy. So the next time you feel low, press play — your mind will thank you.
t2.uzSample:
Musiqa terapiyasi sog'liqni saqlash sohasida tobora ko'proq e'tirof etilmoqda. Men musiqa ham ruhiy, ham jismoniy salomatlik uchun sezilarli terapevtik foyda berishiga qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, musiqa stress va xavotirni kamaytiradi. Tinchlantiruvchi musiqani tinglash kortizol darajasini va yurak urishini pasaytiradi. Ko'p odamlar stressli kunlardan keyin dam olish uchun musiqadan foydalanadilar va hozirda kasalxonalar bemorlar uchun tinchlantiruvchi musiqa qo'yishadi.

Ikkinchidan, musiqa kognitiv funktsiyaga yordam beradi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, musiqa xotirani va diqqatni jamlashni yaxshilaydi. Altsgeymer kasalligi bilan og'rigan bemorlar uchun tanish qo'shiqlar xotiralarni uyg'otishi va kayfiyatni sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin.

Biroq, tanqidchilar ilmiy dalillar hali ham cheklanganligini ta'kidlashadi. Ba'zi foydalar platsebo ta'siri bo'lishi mumkin va musiqa odamlarga turlicha ta'sir qiladi.

Shunga qaramay, musiqaning hissiy kuchi inkor etib bo'lmaydi. U kayfiyatni ko'tarishi, qayg'u paytida tasalli berishi va mashq paytida rag'batlantirishi mumkin. Ushbu psixologik foydalar keng tarqalgan.

Bundan tashqari, musiqa terapiyasi hozirda professional tarzda qo'llanilmoqda. Malakali terapevtlar tuzilgan musiqiy mashg'ulotlar orqali depressiya, autizm va og'riqni boshqarish bilan og'rigan bemorlarga yordam berishadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, musiqaning shifo berish potentsiali haqiqiy va qimmatlidir. Har bir inson musiqani o'zining sog'lomlashtirish tartibiga kiritishi kerak.

Misol uchun, men xafa bo'lganimda, xursandchilik musiqasini tinglayman va bu meni yanada baxtliroq qiladi. Shuningdek, musiqa odamlarning dam olishiga yordam berishi mumkin. Men stressda bo'lganimda, tinchlantiruvchi musiqa tinglayman.

Biroq, ba'zi odamlarga musiqa yoqmasligi mumkin. Ehtimol, u hamma odamlarga ham yordam bermas. Lekin menimcha, u ko'pchilikka yordam beradi. Musiqa, shuningdek, odamlarning o'qish paytida diqqatini jamlashiga yordam berishi mumkin. Misol uchun, men uy vazifalarini qilayotganimda musiqa tinglayman.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, men musiqa odamlar uchun foydali deb hisoblayman. U stress, qayg'u va hatto o'qishda ham yordam berishi mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,

Farrux Yusupov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Talabalar jurnalining tahririyat jamoasiga,

Musiqa terapevtik foydalarga egami degan savol o'rganishga arziydi. Menimcha, musiqa ruhiy va hissiy farovonlik uchun sezilarli afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Bu shunchaki ko'ngilochar narsa emas; u davolash va shaxsiy o'sish uchun kuchli vosita bo'lishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, musiqa stressni kamaytirishga aniq ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatdiki, musiqani tinglash stress bilan bog'liq gormon bo'lgan kortizol darajasini pasaytirishi mumkin. Ko'p odamlar qiyin kundan keyin musiqadan taskin topadilar va ba'zi ish joylari hatto yanada qulay muhit yaratish uchun musiqani qo'shadilar.

Ikkinchidan, musiqa kognitiv funktsiyani yaxshilashi mumkin. Ba'zi tadqiqotlar musiqa va xotira va diqqatni jamlash o'rtasida bog'liqlik borligini ko'rsatadi. Bu soha qo'shimcha o'rganishni talab qilsa-da, anekdot dalillar musiqaning o'rganish va diqqatga ijobiy ta'sirini ko'rsatadi.

Albatta, ba'zilar musiqaning foydalari faqat sub'ektiv yoki hatto platsebo ta'siri deb ta'kidlashadi. To'g'ri, musiqaga individual javoblar juda xilma-xil. Biroq, mavjud dalillarning aksariyati shuni ko'rsatadiki, musiqa kayfiyatga, stress darajasiga va umumiy farovonlikka sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Shuning uchun u terapevtik vosita sifatida jiddiy e'tiborga loyiqdir.

Hurmat bilan,

Farrux Yusupov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the music streaming service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear MelodyStream Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your music streaming service. I am extremely satisfied with the subscription. The music library is vast, covering every genre imaginable. The audio quality is exceptionally crisp, and the personalized playlists have introduced me to fantastic new artists. However, I have some suggestions. The shuffle feature often repeats the same songs. Additionally, the lyrics display isn't available for many tracks. I would appreciate a karaoke mode with synchronized lyrics. Concert alerts for favorite artists would be valuable. Also, a family plan with separate profiles would better suit households with multiple listeners. Overall, MelodyStream has become essential to my daily routine. Yours sincerely, Farrux Yusupov

Hi MelodyStream!

t12.sampleA2:

I like the music. The app is easy, and I like that. But sometimes it is slow. I want more pop music, because I like pop. Thank you.

t12.sampleB1:
Dear MelodyStream Team,

Thank you for your email. I like MelodyStream. The music library is very big, and the sound is good. I listen to music every day now!

However, I think the app could be better. Sometimes it's hard to find new music I like. Also, it would be good if you had more playlists made by other people. I think that would help me discover new artists.

In my opinion, MelodyStream is good, but it could be great!

Thanks,

Farrux Yusupov
t12.sampleB2:
Dear MelodyStream Team,

Thank you for your warm welcome message. Having used MelodyStream Premium for a few weeks now, I would like to share some honest feedback.

On the whole, I am extremely satisfied. The music library is remarkably extensive, covering just about every genre I could ask for, and the audio quality is crystal clear. The app is easy to navigate, so tracking down new songs takes no time at all.

That said, there is still room for improvement. I would strongly recommend adding synchronized lyrics, since a good many tracks currently lack them. A family plan with separate profiles would also appeal to households like mine. Finally, more reliable concert alerts for favourite artists would be a nice touch.

All in all, MelodyStream has quickly become part of my daily routine, and I look forward to watching it grow.

Yours sincerely,
Dilnoza Karimova
